race.description: Tabtouch - Westspeed Platinum Series Ht 2 Hcp
race.comment: BEYOND MEASURE (5) won well fresh before getting back second-up at this track and trip last start. He finished off nicely but never looked likely behind So Si God. Drawn out again now but should be fitter third-up and he spiked third-up last campaign. Can get back to winning ways. COSMIC TREAT (7) disappointed two back before a 0.6L defeat last start at Northam. Drawn wide now, but Fiore rides again and she's not to be discounted if she runs to recent form. HELLUVA GODDESS (1) was just fair first-up in a stronger race but looks better placed coming back to this track and trip. Tsang's claim comes in handy and with improvement likely, she can play a leading role. RIPPER FAROOQ (2) was in good touch before losing the rider last start. That's obviously a forgivable effort and he can be right on target here. SOLDIER OF GOD (10) is next best on the quick turnaround back in trip.
